reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment is expected or provided — consistent with the rule's presence check.

Cited text supports compliance: Sections 2.1 and 2.4 grant Corio (our party) 'nonexclusive' licenses, and Section 2.7 contains only ordinary scope/reverse-engineering restrictions, not a requirements or sole-source covenant.
The only exclusivity-flavored term (Commerce One barred from contacting Corio Customers for non-ASP license sales) runs in our favor, which the detection guidance expressly treats as acceptable.
Exhibit D cooperation is expressly 'non-binding' and no minimum purchase or requirements commitment is cited; deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains.
Rationale appropriately flags that redacted text in Section 2.4 / Exhibit B could change the analysis, which is a fair caveat rather than an unsupported conclusion.
